h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Haridwar

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Haridwar

c: Haridwar's ashrams, yoga centres and dharamshalas already run morning routines for their residents and guests, and an open-air gym sits naturally beside a yoga lawn. FunPlay Systems supplies Fun Fitness outdoor gym equipment to ashrams, trusts, schools, industrial campuses and municipal parks in Haridwar. Our machines are made at our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, about 1,290 km away, and come to Uttarakhand by road.

A guest at an ashram may be any age and may never have used gym equipment before. Simple, slow machines with no weights suit them best. Our installation team or a dealer in north India fixes each one on a grouted or self-standing base, depending on the ground. Tell us how the space is used during the day, and send photos. We will mark the gym area, the clear space for each station and the walking access on a layout drawing for the trust to approve.

items.q: Can an ashram or trust in Haridwar order outdoor gym equipment?
items.a: Yes. We supply trusts, ashrams and other institutions. Send the space available and some photos, and we will suggest machines and send a layout drawing and quote for approval.

items.q: Are the machines suitable for people who have never used a gym?
items.a: Yes. The gentle machines move only as fast as the user moves them, with no weights to lift. Wheels and twisters are the easiest place to start.
Our team or a local dealer grouts the base in concrete or uses a self-standing base. The choice depends on the ground at your site and is shown on the layout.
